```{r libraries,include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(readxl)
```

```{r import data, include=FALSE}
datasheet <- "SSEMG_IS_20260223_label-table.xlsx" #fill in

```

```{r datasheets,include=FALSE}
#change columns if needed

#for note sheets
labsheet <- read_excel(datasheet, sheet ="lab_filter_sheets")
labsheet
labsheets <- data.frame(labsheet)
labsheets
#for ISCO weights
sample_weights <- mutate(labsheets, pre_weight="", post_weight="",notes="")
sample_weights
#for filtering
sample_bottles <- mutate(labsheet, Aqualog = "",Shimadzu = "", CCAL ="",Levoglucosan="",Excess="",notes="") #not sure how to do automatically without something janky
sample_bottles
#for filtering 
filter_weights <- mutate(labsheet,pre_weight="", post_weight="",notes="")
filter_weights


```

# **Sample Bottle weights**

\pagestyle{empty}

Date: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Technician(s): \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

```{r bottle weights, echo=FALSE}
#knitr::kable(sample_weights,booktabs=TRUE, vline = "|",linesep = '') #this does NOTHING. Wanted to add vertical lines and get rid of the line breaks every 5 rows
kable(sample_weights,booktabs=FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped","left","repeat_header"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 10) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "black", background = "#FFF7B0")%>%
  column_spec(ncol(sample_weights), width= "15em") #widen the last row (notes)

```
